answer.reason: In the EIA Connecticut Electricity Profile, Table 1’s net generation figures are annual values in megawatthours. Connecticut’s total annual net generation is on the order of tens of terawatt-hours, so 44,627,596 MWh is implausibly large for the IPP & CHP category. The listed value for IPP & CHP is 133,816 MWh.
